The best choice depends on whether you use a heated humidifier and how many nights of backup power you need.

What matters most when powering a CPAP

Pure sine wave output: Prefer a unit explicitly specified as pure sine wave or approved by your CPAP manufacturer.

Humidifier use: A heated humidifier can substantially increase power consumption. Heated tubing can increase it further.

DC versus AC: If your CPAP manufacturer offers a compatible DC power cable, it can improve runtime compared with powering the machine through an AC inverter.

Backup reliability: For overnight use during outages, consider a fast UPS switchover and test your complete setup before relying on it.
